title: DOJ: Sabungeros cases to proceed despite families’ lack of interest

blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Wednesday said prosecutors will continue pursuing cases against those implicated in the disappearance of sabungeros (cockfighting enthusiasts), despite most victims’ families showing little interest in pursuing the complaints. Chief State Prosecutor Richard Anthony Fadullon said the absence of the families of the victims will not affect the cases. “This is not dependent on the absence or presence of the families of the victims. Napansin namin unti-unti nawawala na ‘yung mga complainants at totally hindi na nakikipag-usap at nakikipag-ugnayan sa amin (We notice that the complainants have started to stop communicating with the prosecutors,” […]...
